title: Next-Generation Collaborative Electronic Medical Record: Resolving Concurrent Conflicts with a Tree CRDT
venue: ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work and Social Computing (CSCW)
abstract: Modern medical issues can cover multiple fields and disciplines, requiring inter-organizational collaboration among healthcare professionals from different specialized background. Shareable medical systems support the distribution of patients' electronic medical record (EMRs) to a variety of specialists, but most of them have no effective resolution mechanisms for concurrent update conflicts on the same EMR, hindering their collaborative abilities.

cited_by.title: MedAI-SciTS: Enhancing Interdisciplinary Collaboration between AI Researchers and Medical Experts
